meta.name: Cave Roof
meta.description: The glue for a cave's limestone roof, stalactites and pillars (gen.caves glues them on). The stone holds only where it hangs on to bedrock, the floor or the rest of the roof: a hit knocks the stone around it loose as dirt, and any piece cut off, such as a stalactite shot through, comes down as dirt on whatever is beneath. Also placeable as a lone stalactite.
